name: template-security-scanner
description: Authorized website and API discovery with isolated local identities and bounded evidence.

scripts.dev: npm run build:console && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx scripts/serve.ts
scripts.check:console: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:console && npm run build:console
scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/settings.test.ts tests/control-plane.test.ts tests/discovery.test.ts tests/assessment-contracts.test.ts tests/bola-bindings.test.ts tests/source-digest.test.ts tests/scripts.test.ts
scripts.test:console: npm run test:console:integration && npm run test:console:browser
scripts.test:console:browser: npm run build:console && vitest run tests/console.browser.test.ts --reporter=verbose --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:assessment: npm run build:console && vitest run tests/example-target.integration.test.ts tests/bola.integration.test.ts tests/bola.browser.integration.test.ts --reporter=verbose --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
scripts.test:advisories: npm run build:console && vitest run tests/advisory-owner.integration.test.ts tests/advisory.browser.test.ts --reporter=verbose --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism
